quote: This study conducts an in-depth analysis of how LMs reason across various contexts, specifically focusing on multi-hop question answering (MHQA).
We conduct an in-depth analysis of how LMs reason across various contexts, specifically focusing on multi-hop question answering (MHQA).

The general Retrieval-augmented Generation (RAG) framework has recently become the cornerstone of many search-based conversational agents, such as Copilot and Doubao. In this setting, LMs frequently need to synthesise information from multiple retrieved search results to provide coherent answers.
outputs: The generated outputs are answers to multi-hop questions, often in the format \boxed{\langle answer \rangle}, based on reasoning over multiple retrieved documents.
